title: Date field shows two-digit dates and the same day as the grid column
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2) in Week view and click Dinner (tomorrow at 7 PM)
Read the date in the card and compare it with the header of the column the event sits in
Press the Up and Down arrow keys in the date field; type another date in the same form and press Return
expected: The date has two digits for month and day with no gap (for example 12/01/2026), in your locale's order, and names the same day as the column the event sits in. Arrow keys change one day; a typed date is accepted; Cancel changes nothing.
